newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Aukland cautions on PresMed, fresh talks.
newsitem.headline: Aukland cautions on PresMed, fresh talks.

text.p: Aukland Investments Ltd said on Friday that its negotiations with President Medical Investments Ltd, referred to in a cautionary last month, are still in progress.
At the same time it had entered into further unrelated talks which could have an effect on its share price on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
It said the PresMed talks should be concluded by May 29 at which date full details of the transaction will be published.
